summary: Acadia Realty Trust filed an 8-K reporting the entry into a Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement for its existing revolving credit facility and term loans. The filing details an extension of the revolving facility maturity to 2030, an increase in term loan amounts, and new tranches. This is a routine refinancing of a credit facility with no change of control, premium, or special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, or strategic review is involved. The filing is a standard material definitive agreement update under Item 1.01.
